def build_module_stubs(entries: Iterable[FunctionDefinition]) -> Dict[str, ModuleStub]:
    module_stubs: Dict[str, ModuleStub] = {}
    
    for entry in entries:
        module_name = entry.module
        
        if module_name not in module_stubs:
            module_stubs[module_name] = ModuleStub()
        
        module_stub = module_stubs[module_name]
        
        func_name = entry.qualname.split('.')[-1]
        func_stub = FunctionStub(
            func_name,
            entry.signature,
            entry.kind,
            is_async=entry.is_async
        )
        
        if '.' in entry.qualname:
            class_name = entry.qualname.split('.')[0]
            if class_name not in module_stub.class_stubs:
                module_stub.class_stubs[class_name] = ClassStub(class_name)
            module_stub.class_stubs[class_name].function_stubs[func_stub.name] = func_stub
        else:
            module_stub.function_stubs[func_stub.name] = func_stub
        
        if entry.typed_dict_class_stubs:
            module_stub.typed_dict_class_stubs.extend(entry.typed_dict_class_stubs)
        
        imports = get_imports_for_signature(entry.signature)
        module_stub.imports_stub.imports.merge(imports)
    
    for module_stub in module_stubs.values():
        for typed_dict_stub in module_stub.typed_dict_class_stubs:
            for attr_stub in typed_dict_stub.attribute_stubs:
                imports = get_imports_for_annotation(attr_stub.typ)
                module_stub.imports_stub.imports.merge(imports)
    
    return module_stubs
